# Test fixture for the boot-menu parser (the original menus.txt was never committed to v4).
# Format:  "menu NAME"; a bare "||||" line opens the UI block (lines there start with a 4-character
# prefix such as "|   "); a second bare "||||" opens the definitions; ";" ends the menu.
menu MAIN
||||
|   [1] Memory   [2] Trace   [3] Floppy
|   [4] Display  [5] Presets
||||
check 1 name memory
check 2 name trace
check 3 name floppy
check 4 name display
check 5 name presets
;
menu MEM
||||
|   [1] 16K RAM    [2] 64K RAM    [3] big RAM
||||
check 1 name smallram
check 2 name ram64k
check 3 name bigram
atmostone 1, 2
atmostone 2, 3
;
menu TRACE
||||
|   trace writes [6]   trace reads [7]
|   after N writes [8]
||||
check 6 name trace-writes
check 7 name trace-reads
decimal 8 name after-n-writes
;
menu FLOPPY
||||
|   [1] floppy from flash   [2] floppy from PC
||||
check 1 name floppy-fd
check 2 name floppy-pc
exactlyone 1, 2
;
menu DISPLAY
||||
|   [1] CoCo 3 mode
||||
check 1 name become-coco3
;
menu PRESET
||||
|   [L] load   [S] save
||||
action L name load-preset
action S name save-preset
;
